# Breve

[Index](../index.md) · [Rules](../rules.md) · [Sources](../sources.md)

A latte or cappuccino made with half-and-half instead of milk.

- Is a: [Cappuccino](c-cappuccino.md), [Latte](c-latte.md)

- **contains:** What goes into the drink.
- **espressoToMilkRatio:** Parts espresso per part milk, so 1 means equal parts.
- **origin:** Where the drink was first made.
- **pourOrder:** What goes in the cup first, and what goes on top.
- **pullVolumeMl:** Milliliters of espresso pulled for one drink.
- **texture:** How the milk feels.
- **variationOf:** A drink this one is a twist on.

## Rules

- [Breve uses half-and-half](../rules.md#rule-breve-uses-half-and-half) (MUST): A Breve MUST be made with HalfAndHalf. Source: [Vertex Coffee house guide > Breve, line 9](../sources.md#loc-vertex-coffee-house-guide-q2hn8f).
  > A breve must use half-and-half, never whole milk.

- [Milk drinks have milk](../rules.md#rule-milk-drinks-have-milk) (inherited from [MilkDrink](c-milk-drink.md), MUST): A MilkDrink MUST contain a milk ingredient. Source: [Vertex Coffee house guide > Milk drinks, line 5](../sources.md#loc-vertex-coffee-house-guide-bdsph9).
  > Every milk drink must contain milk or cream.
